records.label: spacr.qt.mask_engine.load_volume_image_and_mask#1
records.source: TIFF volumes need exactly three spatial axes, in any order. A plain three-dimensional page stack (tifffile's ``Q`` or ``I`` page axis over ``YX``) is read as Z sections, as z-stacks and FIB-SEM series are saved. One channel axis (``CZYX``, ``ZCYX``, at most 16 channels) is kept as :attr:`VolumeMaskSession.channels`; the slice views show the first channel. Time and colour axes are refused. ``voxel_spacing`` metadata is read in storage-axis order. OME physical sizes are converted to micrometres; ImageJ spacing and XY resolution are retained. MRC volumes (``.mrc``, ``.rec``, ``.map``) are read as ZYX with their voxel size in nanometres; they need the optional ``mrcfile`` package. Absent physical metadata means pixel coordinates. Numeric NPY volumes require an explicitly reviewed ZYX layout and image channel; their spacing is in pixels and pickle is disabled. Labels retain dtype and identity. A saved geometry sidecar is bound to the exact source file and mask pixels and is refused when stale.
records.context: TIFF volumes need exactly three spatial axes, in any order. A plain three-dimensional page stack (tifffile's ``Q`` or ``I`` page axis over ``YX``) is read as Z sections, as z-stacks and FIB-SEM series are saved. One image data channel axis (``CZYX``, ``ZCYX``, at most 16 image data channels) is kept as :attr:`VolumeMaskSession.channels`; the slice views show the first image data channel. Time and colour axes are refused. ``voxel_spacing`` metadata is read in storage-axis order. OME physical sizes are converted to micrometres; ImageJ spacing and XY resolution are retained. MRC volumes (``.mrc``, ``.rec``, ``.map``) are read as ZYX with their voxel size in nanometres; they need the optional ``mrcfile`` package. Absent physical metadata means pixel coordinates. Numeric NPY volumes require an explicitly reviewed ZYX layout and image data channel; their spacing is in pixels and pickle is disabled. Labels retain dtype and identity. A saved geometry sidecar is bound to the exact source file and mask pixels and is refused when stale.
records.translation: TIFF 볼륨에는 순서에 관계없이 정확히 세 개의 공간 축이 필요합니다. tifffile ``Q`` 또는 ``I`` 페이지 축이 ``YX`` 위에 놓인 평범한 3차원 페이지 스택은 z-스택과 FIB-SEM 시리즈가 저장되는 방식대로 Z 단면으로 읽습니다. 하나의 채널 축(``CZYX``, ``ZCYX``, 최대 16개 채널)은 :attr:`VolumeMaskSession.channels` 에 유지되며 슬라이스 뷰는 첫 번째 채널을 표시합니다. 시간 축과 색상 축은 거부됩니다. ``voxel_spacing`` 메타데이터는 저장 축 순서로 읽습니다. OME 물리 크기는 마이크로미터로 변환되고, ImageJ 간격과 XY 해상도는 유지됩니다. MRC 볼륨(``.mrc``, ``.rec``, ``.map``)은 나노미터 단위의 복셀 크기와 함께 ZYX로 읽으며, 선택적 ``mrcfile`` 패키지가 필요합니다. 물리 메타데이터가 없으면 픽셀 좌표를 뜻합니다. 숫자형 NPY 볼륨에는 명시적으로 검토된 ZYX 레이아웃과 이미지 채널이 필요하며, 간격은 픽셀 단위이고 pickle은 비활성화됩니다. 레이블은 dtype과 정체성을 유지합니다. 저장된 기하 보조 파일은 정확한 원본 파일과 마스크 픽셀에 묶여 있으며, 오래된 경우 거부됩니다.
